sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 147

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 147:1
items.html: (To the question) All the aspects of addition in ZA, which are from the GAR of Ruach and above, ascend to AVI in the secret of MAN. And only the aspect of Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach, which is in him permanently, remains below in the secret of the slumber. (Item 84).
